g.text: Panel A percentages use all taxa; panel B percentages use insects only. Insects are also included within Arthropoda in panel A.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Counts are distinct resolved NCBI taxa, not specimens, assemblies or sequence volume. Multiple ToL IDs on a row are counted once.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Branch lengths are TimeTree point estimates (Ma); uncertainty is not shown. Group tips are placed at the present, with within-group diversification collapsed.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #43525c

g.text: Scope: the supplied annotation-complete snapshot, not the entire DToL project. Colours indicate major lineages; there is one cohort in this file.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #65727a

g.text: Sources: supplied dtol.csv; NCBI Taxonomy name resolution; TimeTree higher-taxon exports (accessed 2026-11-17). See the companion source manifest for mappings and hashes.
